method: every import in src/litcritic is parsed (ast) and checked against sys.stdlib_module_names
kit: lc kit builds a zip with the package, data, schemas, checklist, prompts, START_HERE.md and an lc.py launcher; extracted to an empty folder it passes `python -I lc.py doctor` (ingest, anchor, metrics, queries, pack in a temp workspace) and `checklist validate`; START_HERE commands are checked by the prompt reference gate
